title: Rehearsal marks
description: A rehearsal mark is an arbitrary index into the score, used to coordinate players in rehearsal. It carries no musical meaning of its own — renumbering every mark in a score changes nothing about the music. Rehearsal marks are conventionally drawn in a box. That follows from the object being a rehearsal mark, so the document does not encode it. Proposed MNX objects, not yet adopted — see roadmap/proposed/score-text.md.
